transcript.text: Ladies and gentlemen, please join the USO in honoring WWE hometown hero, Staff Sergeant Jonathan Hernandez.
He's a United States Marine Corps veteran served right here in California and supported missions around the world.
He completed more than 16 military jumps and served as a Marine Corps Marshal Arts Instructor.
Congratulations, Staff Sergeant Jonathan Hernandez and thank you for your service.
